The broadcast is produced under live television conditions, and local broadcast delays, edits and streaming availability can affect what different viewers see.
Sketches may be cut, shortened or altered between rehearsal and broadcast, and some material may be released separately afterward.
The show has no official competition phases, eliminations, twists, finale vote or season winner, so these game mechanics do not apply.

blocks.tagline: Live comedy, topical satire, sketches and musical performances
blocks.premise: Saturday Night Live is a live late-night variety and sketch-comedy show built around a guest host, a regular comedy cast and a musical guest. Each episode mixes topical humor, character sketches, recurring news satire and live music, with surprise appearances and unexpected moments sometimes adding to the fun. There is no elimination game or season champion; each broadcast is its own collection of performances.

phases.name: Weekly Broadcast
phases.summary: Each episode follows the variety-show format, combining a guest host, comedy sketches, Weekend Update and musical performances without a season-long elimination or competitive progression.

segments.name: Cold Open
segments.summary: A sketch, often built around current events, politics or recognizable public situations, opens the show before the opening titles.

segments.name: Opening Monologue
segments.summary: The guest host addresses the audience with jokes, observations or a comedic performance that introduces the night's host.

segments.name: Comedy Sketches
segments.summary: The cast and guest host perform scripted or character-based comedy across a variety of settings, formats and topical subjects.

segments.name: Weekend Update
segments.summary: A recurring satirical news segment presents jokes about current events and may include fictional characters or guest appearances.

segments.name: Musical Performance
segments.summary: The musical guest performs songs live as part of the broadcast, typically in two separate appearances.

segments.name: Goodnights
segments.summary: The cast, guest host and musical guest gather for the closing moments of the broadcast.
